subject: Sensitive role notifications, condensed timeline, and manager templates
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: hr-ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sensitive role notifications, condensed timeline, and manager templates

Team —

Quick note to align on a compact review timeline and the comms/templates we'll use for sensitive-role notifications this cycle. We need to balance speed (org changes must land before product milestone code freeze on June 15) with a compassionate process for affected employees. High level proposal below, and two attachments: "sensitive-notice-templates_v1.docx" and "condensed-timeline-runbook.pdf".

Proposed condensed timeline (targeting managers only this first wave):
- May 10: Manager email + manager pack released (templates + FAQ)
- May 12–16: Manager 1:1s with impacted ICs (HR partner present for high-sensitivity cases)
- May 17: Final manager confirmation of outcomes (HR verifies paperwork)
- May 20: Company-wide announcement for non-sensitive roles / teams if needed

Sensitive-role considerations:
- Two manager email templates: one for role-change (redeployment) and one for separation.
- Standard language for confidentiality and next-step offers (coaching, redeployment support, severance outline).
- A separate confidential route for managers to flag high-risk cases (legal/comp/security) to People Ops.

Action items / asks: 
1) Please review the templates and the runbook and send redlines by EOD Monday (May 3).
2) Confirm whether we can shorten manager notice to "48 hours to prepare" for this wave, or if we keep to a 5-business-day prep window.
3) Monica: can you confirm legal/comp sign-off timeline and whether external counsel (Carol Sims at Piper) should be engaged immediately?

I want to keep the manager-facing comms short and prescriptive — a clear subject line, a short opener, and three bullets: what to say, what not to say, and where to escalate.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sensitive-notice-templates_v1.docx (docx), condensed-timeline-runbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, hr-ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sensitive role notifications, condensed timeline, and manager templates

Kim —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick thoughts inline: 
- I like the compact timeline but recommend we don't push the manager prep window shorter than 72 hours for any separation notices — managers need time to coordinate with their HR partner and review calibrations.
- Please add an "opt-in coaching and redeployment" line in the templates; we've had good uptake on that in the past.
- Legal sign-off: we should not engage external counsel by default; have Monica confirm if the severance language or any role-specific constraints require Piper.

I'll add a few redlines to the docx and share comments in Drive.

Subject: Re: Sensitive role notifications, condensed timeline, and manager templates

Thanks — I reviewed both attachments and the proposed timeline. A few items from Legal/Compensation to note: 
1) Legal: For standard redeployment offers and internal transfers we are clear. If any separation includes a change to previously agreed-upon commission/bonus terms, escalate to Legal. If there's a non-compete or ND clause to interpret, we may need Piper involved; I think we can confirm this by May 6.
2) Compensation: Payroll cutoff for final payouts is May 28 for June 1 effective dates; if we need earlier effective dates we must coordinate with Finance (I will loop them in if required).
3) Compliance checklist attached below (internal): ensure manager collects acknowledgement of receipt (not acceptance), and use the HR case number template for tracking.

I approve the condensed timeline for manager communications provided we preserve the 72-hour prep window for any separation notices. I'll attach the compliance checklist to Drive and share link.

Also copying external partner at Piper for visibility (Carol Sims) in case we need counsel quickly.

—
Monica Patel
People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: hr-ops@redwoodinference.com, Carol Sims <carol@piper-consulting.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sensitive role notifications, condensed timeline, and manager templates

Thanks for the quick feedback — summary and decisions below: 
- Manager prep window: 72 hours minimum before any separation notice. We will keep a 48-hour prep allowed only for redeployment conversations where no change to pay/bonus is required.
- Legal escalation: Monica will confirm by May 6 whether Piper engagement is required; otherwise we will not engage external counsel.
- Timezone/payroll: Marcus to add payroll cutoffs and an East/West timeline appendix to the runbook (timeline-v2.xlsx).
- Templates: I incorporated Laura's opt-in coaching paragraph and tightened separation language. Finalized templates attached as "sensitive-notice-templates_final.docx".

Next steps: 
1) Monica to confirm by May 6 on legal/comp triggers.
2) Marcus to finalize the timeline workbook with timezone appendix by May 5.
3) Laura to review final templates and confirm by May 5 for manager release on May 10.
4) I'll schedule a 20-minute leadership sync on May 6 to sign off. Invite to follow.

If there are no material objections, we'll proceed with distribution to managers on May 10 and HR will standby for in-person support the week of May 12.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference
